title: 'Peak', The Beloved Indie Climber, Scales October's Stacked Switch 2 Release Schedule
summary:
Launching next week!

Ever since we first saw Peak climb onto PC last year, we have been jonesing for a Switch 2 port. Aggro Crab and Landfall Games have been teasing that something was in the works for a few months, and now we finally know what it was: Peak is coming to Switch 2!

The devs revealed that this beloved indie mountain climber will plant its flag on consoles on 22nd October (yep, as in next week), making an already stacked release month even busier.

title: Preview: 'Eternal Anima' Returns To The Past To Create A Modern JRPG
summary:
Back to the future.

Originally revealed in 2023 as a working title named Project Life is RPG, Marvelous didn't show too much of their new IP, but said they were creating a game that pays respect to the classics of the genre, along with some gorgeous concept art. Jump forward to this year, and Eternal Anima was officially unveiled in September's Nintendo Direct.

A bunch of game industry veterans are working on this title, such as Katsuhisa Higuchi (Final Fantasy, Chrono Trigger, Chrono Cross, Xenogears), Kazushige Nojima (Final Fantasy, Kingdom Hearts), and Keisuke Makino (Metaphor: ReFantazio, Persona 5), to name a few.

title: Nintendo Announces Switch 2 Repair Price Hike For Japan
summary:
Effective as of 16th November 2026.

Switch 2 and Switch have already been hit with global price hikes in 2026, and now, Nintendo has announced it will increase the cost of hardware repairs in Japan.

According to an official notice on Nintendo's Japanese website, the price revision (which will be applied to both the Switch 2 and Switch) will take effect next month on 16th November 2026.

title: Hitman: Absolution Finally Sneaks Onto Switch 2 Next Week
summary:
Another October game?!

Almost a full year after releasing on the Switch, Hitman: Absolution - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition is finally hitting the eShop on 22nd October 2026.

This new version will bring mouse compatibility along with increased resolution and a new performance mode targeting 60fps in both handheld and docked modes. Those who own the Switch version already have until 5th November 2026 to upgrade for free. After that, the upgrade pack will cost $9.99 / €4,99 / £4.99.

title: "No Offense To Zelda" - Activision Exec Says Call Of Duty: MW4 And GTA 6 Are The Two Biggest Games Of The Year
summary:
How to p*** off Nintendo fans in four words.

With most upcoming games fleeing from the November release window to avoid Grand Theft Auto VI, Nintendo is bucking the trend with the launch of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on the 5th – two weeks ahead of Rockstar's epic.

It's become quite the talking point in the industry and beyond, with even Saturday Night Live dedicating its weekend update skit to the two titles. However, Activision's chief marketing officer Tyler Bahl downplayed Zelda's potential impact upon launch in an interview with The Game Business, and instead believes that GTA VI will drive more players towards Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4.

title: Japanese Charts: Kingdom Hearts Collection Grabs The Top Spot, Despite A Slow Start
summary:
Taking the Mickey.

Famitsu has shared the latest look at the Japanese physical gaming charts, and there's another newbie on the podium.

Despite not even reaching the podium in the UK, Kingdom Hearts Collection nabbed the top spot in Japan, with just 23,411 units to its name. Not all that many sales for a debut, but it was a pretty quiet week out there, with Rhythm Heaven Groove landing in second and last week's champ, Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve flying into third.

title: Video: Digital Foundry Delivers Its Tech Review For Resident Evil 4 On Switch 2
summary:
Plus impressions for RE2 and 3.

Digital Foundry has provided its tech review for Resident Evil 4 on Switch 2, while also sharing some brief impressions of RE2 and RE3.

Starting with RE4, it's noted that the game has a "range of downgrades" compared to its PS5 counterpart, which isn't particularly surprising. Some local light sources don't cast real-time shadows in some situations, though the shadows that are there are at least at a similar resolution.

title: Nintendo's London Comic-Con Booth Features Playable Layton, Metaphor, 007 & More
summary:
19 games to try.

Nintendo is returning to MCM London Comic-Con later this month from 23rd - 25th October, and it has got quite the roster of playable demos lined up.

As shared on the company's socials today, the Nintendo booth will let attendees go hands-on with upcoming titles like Professor Layton and The New World of Steam, Metaphor: ReFantazio, 007 First Light, Rayman Legends Retold and Monster Hunter Wilds. There's also the chance to check out some of the Switch 2's best releases to date, with Donkey Kong Bananza, Pokémon Pokopia and Splatoon Raiders all making an appearance.

title: This Gorgeous 'Stop-Motion' Adventure Swims Onto Switch 2 Next Month
summary:
The name's Halibut, Harold Halibut.

Harold Halibut released back in 2024 with one of those visual styles that immediately made us sit up and pay attention. In the two years since, we have been hoping that its stop-motion-esque stylings might one day make the jump to Switch and next month, it's set to do exactly that.

Developer Slow Bros announced yesterday that Harold Halibut will arrive on Switch 2 on 12th November, and while there's every chance that we might be a little preoccupied with certain other games around then, we think it'll be well worth a look.
